# statusdrift_incident (Data Source)

Fetches a single incident by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the incident.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the incident was created.
- `message` (String) The incident message.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The ID of the monitor this incident belongs to.
- `priority` (String) The priority of the incident.
- `resolved` (Boolean) Whether the incident is resolved.
- `resolved_at` (String) When the incident was resolved.
